import unittest

from solution import render_waypoints


class RenderWaypointsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_route_and_coordinate_formatting(self):
        source = "2\nHarbor Route\nA 1 -2.5 3e1\nXYZ 0.0004 4.1256 -0.5\n"
        expected = (
            "ROUTE Harbor Route\n"
            "A 1.000 1 -2.500 1 30.000 1\n"
            "XYZ 0.000 1 4.126 1 -0.500 1\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(render_waypoints(source), expected)

    def test_zero_count_and_trailing_blank_lines(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_waypoints("0\nEmpty Route\n"), "ROUTE Empty Route\n")
        self.assertEqual(render_waypoints("0\nEmpty Route\n\n\n"), "ROUTE Empty Route\n")
        self.assertEqual(render_waypoints("1\nRoute\nAB 1 2 3\n\n"),
                         "ROUTE Route\nAB 1.000 1 2.000 1 3.000 1\n")

    def test_non_string_raises_type_error(self):
        for value in (None, b"0\nRoute", 1):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    render_waypoints(value)

    def test_invalid_headers_and_counts(self):
        invalid = (
            "",
            "0",
            "0\n",
            "0\n\n",
            "-1\nRoute\n",
            "+1\nRoute\nA 1 2 3\n",
            "1.0\nRoute\nA 1 2 3\n",
            "one\nRoute\n",
        )
        for source in invalid:
            with self.subTest(source=source):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    render_waypoints(source)

    def test_malformed_records(self):
        invalid = (
            "1\nRoute\nA 1 2\n",
            "1\nRoute\nA 1 2 3 4\n",
            "1\nRoute\na 1 2 3\n",
            "1\nRoute\nABCD 1 2 3\n",
            "1\nRoute\nA1 1 2 3\n",
            "1\nRoute\nÅ 1 2 3\n",
            "1\nRoute\nA x 2 3\n",
            "1\nRoute\n\nA 1 2 3\n",
        )
        for source in invalid:
            with self.subTest(source=source):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    render_waypoints(source)

    def test_non_finite_coordinates(self):
        for coordinate in ("nan", "NaN", "inf", "-inf", "Infinity"):
            with self.subTest(coordinate=coordinate):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    render_waypoints("1\nRoute\nA " + coordinate + " 2 3\n")

    def test_count_mismatch_and_extra_content(self):
        invalid = (
            "2\nRoute\nA 1 2 3\n",
            "1\nRoute\nA 1 2 3\nB 4 5 6\n",
            "0\nRoute\nunexpected\n",
            "1\nRoute\nA 1 2 3\n\nunexpected\n",
        )
        for source in invalid:
            with self.subTest(source=source):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    render_waypoints(source)

    def test_input_is_unchanged(self):
        source = "1\nRoute\nA 1 2 3\n"
        original = source
        render_waypoints(source)
        self.assertEqual(source, original)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
